# Zstore AI

> Zstore AI is the independent web design and development studio of Zvi Moshe, based in Tel Aviv, working with clients worldwide. One person designs and hand-codes custom websites, online stores, landing pages, UI/UX and integrations on open web standards: no templates, no page builders, no hand-offs. Contact: zstore.ai295@gmail.com · WhatsApp +972 58 729 2029.

Zstore AI is a one-person studio: the person you brief (Zvi Moshe) is the person who designs and builds the site. Founded in 2024. There are two ways to work together: a fixed project price based on the agreed scope (the client owns the design, code and content outright at handover, with an optional monthly Care plan afterward), or a monthly plan (website as a service) in which Zvi hosts, secures, maintains and keeps improving the site, with the option to buy it out anytime. No prices are published; quotes follow a short conversation. Every launch includes 30 days of post-launch care. Zvi works in English and Hebrew and replies within one business day.

The canonical site of the English-language studio is https://zstore-ai.com/. Zvi also runs a separate Hebrew-language site at https://zstore-ai.co.il/ (linked from the footer credit).

## Key facts

- Name: Zstore AI
- Founder, designer and developer: Zvi Moshe
- Founded: 2024
- Location: Tel Aviv. Clients worldwide; remote and asynchronous by default, with calls in the shared time-zone window (Tel Aviv is 2 hours ahead of London, 7 ahead of New York, 10 ahead of Los Angeles)
- Languages: English and Hebrew
- Email: zstore.ai295@gmail.com
- WhatsApp: +972 58 729 2029 (https://wa.me/972587292029)
- GitHub: https://github.com/zvi293
- Track record: 40+ projects shipped, 98% client retention, ~1.2s average load time
- Response time: within one business day
- How sites are built: designed from scratch and hand-coded on open web standards (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, open-source tools), never on a rented platform or page builder
- Typical timelines: landing pages 1–2 weeks; full marketing sites 4–6 weeks (depends on scope, content readiness and integrations)
- Process: Discover, Design, Develop, Launch
- Ownership: the domain is registered in the client's name and the content they supplied is always theirs
- Accessibility: this site targets WCAG 2.2 AA and offers an on-page accessibility panel

## Services

- [Services](https://zstore-ai.com/services/): Overview of everything Zstore AI designs and builds, including digital product design (UI/UX, prototyping, design systems), code and connections (payments, forms, content management, integrations) and refinement and care (performance, accessibility, SEO foundations, ongoing support).
- [Custom website design](https://zstore-ai.com/services/custom-website-design/): Custom websites designed from scratch and hand-coded by Zvi Moshe; full marketing sites typically take 4–6 weeks, at a fixed price based on the agreed scope or on a monthly plan.
- [E-commerce websites](https://zstore-ai.com/services/ecommerce-websites/): Custom-coded online stores focused on clear product pages, a short checkout and mobile shopping, with secure checkout through an established payment provider and integrations connected.
- [Landing pages](https://zstore-ai.com/services/landing-pages/): Single-goal landing pages for launches, ads and campaigns, hand-coded for speed; most take 1–2 weeks.
- [AI search optimization](https://zstore-ai.com/services/ai-search-optimization/): GEO/AEO foundations that help AI search tools find, understand and cite a site: crawler access, structured data, answer-first content and consistent business facts, with no guaranteed placement.
- [Website redesign](https://zstore-ai.com/services/website-redesign/): Redesigns that protect what already works (URLs, content, search visibility) and fix what doesn't, from a focused refresh to a full rebuild.

## Guides

- [Guides](https://zstore-ai.com/guides/): Plain-English guides for business owners on AI search, strategy, building, launching and accessibility, written by Zvi Moshe.
- [Web design glossary](https://zstore-ai.com/guides/glossary/): 62 alphabetical, plain-English definitions of web design, development, SEO, GEO/AEO, e-commerce and accessibility terms.
- [What is generative engine optimization (GEO)?](https://zstore-ai.com/guides/generative-engine-optimization/): How AI search tools choose sources, how GEO relates to SEO, what Google says, and seven honest steps to get cited.
- [Custom website vs website builder](https://zstore-ai.com/guides/custom-website-vs-website-builder/): An honest comparison of Squarespace, Wix or Webflow against a custom website, including when a builder is the better choice.
- [How to write a website brief](https://zstore-ai.com/guides/how-to-write-a-website-brief/): The nine sections of a useful website brief, guiding questions, a fill-in template and an example.
- [Website launch checklist](https://zstore-ai.com/guides/website-launch-checklist/): What to check before launch, on launch day and in the first 30 days, plus extra steps for relaunches (redirects).
- [Website accessibility and the ADA](https://zstore-ai.com/guides/website-accessibility-ada/): How the ADA applies to websites, the 2024 DOJ Title II rule and its compliance dates, WCAG AA in practice, why overlays aren't a fix, first steps and laws outside the US; not legal advice.
- [Core Web Vitals, explained for business owners](https://zstore-ai.com/guides/core-web-vitals/): What LCP, INP and CLS measure, the good thresholds (2.5 s, 200 ms, 0.1 at the 75th percentile of visits), how they affect Google rankings, how to check them in PageSpeed Insights and Search Console, and the fixes that usually help.
